answer:
zgrep probes **up to 4 regular files**, in the **root directory**, on the **main thread** before the thread pool is created (src/kamikaze.zig:743-745). If a match is found right away, it returns true without spawning any threads (src/kamikaze.zig:745-746).

The probe runs per root. A wrapper loops over `roots` and calls `tryQuickQuietProbe` on each one. On a hit, it sets `stats.early_aborted = true` and returns true (src/kamikaze.zig:814-818). So with multiple roots, the limit applies to each root separately.

The context doesn't show the body of `tryQuickQuietProbe`, so I can't confirm the 4-file limit in code. That figure comes from the doc comment only.
